meaning: Logical transcription/instantiation of occupant N1 at the selected whole: if the whole occupies no region it does not exist at that world. This scope consequence does not establish relationalism or refute the located-whole escape.

strong_version_needed.STMT-NATURALISM-N1: This comparison tests N1 over every existing candidate. N2 would constrain only the concrete subset and would need an additional explicit classification bridge; that is a different configuration, not a replacement justified by this signature.
